domain_guidance.summary: This domain specifically covers project purpose, target audience needs, intellectual property regulations, copyright terms, digital graphics terminology, color representation, and general design principles for visual communication projects without missing any core concepts.

This section focuses heavily on document creation, modification settings for intended outputs, artboard management, asset placement, linking procedures, saving documents, and properly exporting both vector and raster graphics for different publication mediums.

Candidates explore workspace customization, preference configurations, basic design aids like rulers and guides, color swatches, gradients, brushes, symbols, patterns, and complex layer hierarchy management techniques to maintain organized project files.
Centers on creating and modifying objects, paths, and text using core tools like the Pen tool, shape tools, image trace, type tools, and adjustments to appearance and object position.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at your test center or launch your online proctored session ready for a linear exam format. Manage your time across the 40 questions within the 50-minute time limit.

faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of 40 questions presented in a linear, computer-based format. Question types include traditional multiple choice questions and performance-based tasks specific to Adobe Certified Professional exams.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for the Adobe Certified Professional — Illustrator certification exam is 66. Candidates must successfully meet or exceed this required score to earn their official credential.

The certification exam has a strict total duration of 50 minutes. Candidates should carefully pace themselves throughout the testing session to complete all questions within this designated time frame.
The standard price for taking the certification exam is $180. Official vouchers or direct test registrations can be purchased conveniently through Certiport or Pearson VUE platforms.

editorial.overview: The Adobe Certified Professional in Illustrator certification exam comprehensively validates your professional knowledge and practical competencies in using Adobe Illustrator, the premier vector graphics application. Certified directly by Adobe, this complete test evaluates candidates across four distinct domains using exactly 40 questions presented in a linear, computer-based testing format designed to measure your capabilities effectively.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review all official exam objectives and take extensive CertPREP practice tests powered by GMetrix to fully experience the official computer-based testing format. Gain ample hands-on practice with core vector tools, artboards, and layers to adequately prepare for multiple-choice questions and performance-based tasks during your studies.
editorial.who_should_take: Graphic designers, digital artists, and students seeking to validate their vector illustration skills. Candidates should have practical experience using Adobe Illustrator to create logos, icons, drawings, and typography for print, web, video, and mobile outputs.

exam_price_notes: Standard price $180 via Certiport or Pearson VUE.
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. ACP exams include both multiple-choice questions and performance-based tasks in a simulated application environment. AD0-E series exams are multiple-choice only.
id_requirements: One government-issued photo ID with full name. Name must match registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Adobe's certification programme site lists the Illustrator credential among its live certifications - 'Graphic Design & Illustration Using Adobe Illustrator' under Certifications (Firefly, Express, Acrobat Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere, After Effects, Animate, Dreamweaver) - and explains 'To offer the highest-quality exams, Adobe partners with Certiport, the leader in performance-based testing.'

renewal_options: ACP (Creative Cloud) certifications are version-specific and do not expire but may become outdated with new software versions. Adobe Experience Cloud certifications (AD0-E series) are valid for 2 years; renewal by passing a current renewal exam at no charge.

retake_policy.notes: 30-day waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake. Third and subsequent attempts require 14-day waiting period.
